title: Petra and the Portrait Anew
author: P. M. Dunmore
blurb: Felix Okonkwo, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, has spent twenty years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
